programme.desc: Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew; he must take point on one of the most delicate parts of the con the Cool Off; despite the crew's help, the situation spins out of control.
programme.sub-title: The Cooling off the Mark Job

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
programme.desc: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
programme.desc: After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: After starting on the second front, the Allies broke out of Normandy and launch the Red Army. In the East, the invasion of the Philippines will bring the Allies one step closer to the home islands.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: We've seen the main action of the fighting in Belgium, Battle of the Bulge, and the decisive event of the winter campaign. We will sum up the entire battle ending in the allied victory and drive into German as Hitler underestimated America's leaders.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: The activities of the 1st and 6th Marine Divisions on the island.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: A war that reached every continent and touched every sort of terrain demanded a wide variety of strategies and tactics: Dunkirk, Malaya, The River Plate, Operation Market Garden, Syria and The Battle Of Berlin.
programme.sub-title: Jungle & City fighting, Sea Battles, Invasions, Advances & Retreats

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: For prisoners, life in camp was one of brutal forced labor, daily violence, hunger, thirst, disease and omnipresent death. In the midst of horror, everyone tried to find a way to survive...

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This film describes events in Korea from August 10 to September 20, 1950. We see how American troops fought to hold on to the Pusan perimeter, the air support they received from carriers, and the march on Seoul. It also includes a report from Lieutenant Tom Dreisenstock, Platoon Leader of the 24th Infantry Division.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: Turning of the Tide

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David reveals the legendary characters, audacious missions and makeshift methods of spying's early days, and uncovers the real heroes and heroines who were pivotal to Allied victory in World War I.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On D-Day and later in June 1944, the USS TEXAS was called on to help silence the batteries of German artillery and gun positions defending the landing beaches and the port city of Cherbourg. The USS Texas, a veteran battleship with 128 guns, in a fierce battle, faced off against the powerful German guns, helping to secure a key victory in the Normandy campaign.
programme.sub-title: The Fabulous Destiny of the Battleship Texas

programme.title: Pearl Harbor Heroes
programme.desc: With heroes at its heart and history as its backbone, this astonishingly visceral documentary will tell the definitive story of Pearl Harbour. Employing a minute-by-minute timeline and using PhotoG, a new forensic visual technique, combined with archive material, eyewitness testimony and dramatisations, this new documentary takes us into the action and shows what it was really like.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: October 1941, Germany's Army Group Center is only some 25 km west of Moscow. The Russian winter, however, is only a few weeks away. With not enough soldiers or military equipment, the Soviet high command's only hope left is that the weather will save the capital. The battle ends in a bloody failure for the German Army, and it is forced to retreat.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Replays the drama and battle action of the period of the landing at Normandy and the fierce combat to overcome the wall of 'Fortress Europe' in June 1944.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'
programme.sub-title: The Capture of the Cherbourg Peninsular

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Eisenhower halts Monty's costly gamble as British forces retreat before destruction. Heavy casualties and strategic failures haunt the Allies, with lasting effects for the war's remainder.

programme.title: Visions of War: World War II Women - We Can Do It!
programme.desc: Shows the daily life and work of the army nurse, including training and off-duty activities.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: Germany's 'revenge weapons'-V1 and V2 missiles-heralded a new kind of war. Jet and rocket planes came too late to help. In Japan, kamikaze pilots struck fear, but a single weapon changed everything: the A-Bomb. As WWII ended, the bomber had reshaped warfare-and opened the door to the nuclear age.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: This episode chronicles the US bombing invasion of Germany. We will see the great engineering of our aircraft, carrying out their bombing mission with precision.

programme.title: Vietnam Peace Negotiations
programme.desc: 27 January 1973. After five years of negotiations in Paris, the Americans and the Vietnamese made peace, in what had been a difficult process.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Special Forces
programme.desc: From WWII to the present, witness the daring heroics of Britain's SAS (Special Air Service) and SBS (Special Boat Service), and meet America's Delta Force.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The series begins with the German invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, a surprise attack that ignited the Second World War. This episode explores the swift and brutal tactics of Blitzkrieg, the political miscalculations of European leaders, and the failure of appeasement. Through rare footage and expert analysis, we witness how the seeds of global conflict were sown.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: The post WWII years were a technological boom period. Watch the history of rockets and missiles as the world's first guided missile is created during WWI. Witness the first operational jet bomber, the B-47 as it takes over from its predecessors.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The ultimate test of tank technology is the battlefield. American tanks form the sharp end of the sword in Desert Storm. The U.S. marine corp was still using the older M-60 tank, although with some modifications.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Infantry Firepower
programme.desc: Documentary looking at the weapons used by infantry soldiers in the Second World War. Includes such weapons as the mortar, the landmine, the bazooka and the hand grenade. The programme features graphics, animation, archive footage and interviews with expert Robin Clifton.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: Precision airstrikes have become the big stick of international relations. When diplomacy fails and military action is chosen, the missile armed strike aircraft is at the center of combat. Many nations deploy advanced jet aircrafts and high-tech missiles, but only one has the broad range of technologies and forces to deploy such weapons on a global scale, the United States.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944, at dawn, 156,000 men are preparing to disembark with five objectives of the Normandy coast. This is Operation Overlord. Among them, combatants which we often forget about their active participation in the liberation of Europe... These are the 15,000 Canadians of the 3rd Infantry Division. They must arrive on a beach five miles wide, code name: Juno.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: This episode dramatically details the outbreak of the world's first jet war. On June 24, 1950, Communist North Korea invaded her sister to the south, forcing a war. Within days, America had F-80s knocking out Communist supply lines.
programme.sub-title: War of Korea: On to the Yalu

programme.title: Blitzkrieg: The Lightning War
programme.desc: Poland invaded 1939, with the use of powerful archive film footage and highly detailed computer generated battle maps, charts the progress of a deprived post World War I Germany. We follow the rapid and spectacular military build-up, through to the largely horse-drawn invasions of Czechoslovakia and Poland.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: This film was made by the U.S. Army and directed by George Stevens. As the Allies reached Germany, General Eisenhower ordered George Stevens to film the concentration camps. The camps are filmed and survivors interviewed. This film was evidence at the Nuremberg Trials.

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: The arrival of the 1st Provisional Marine Brigade in August 1950 bolstered the U.S. forces in the Pusan perimeter. The attacking North Korean army was stalled in the attempt to overrun the perimeter.

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: After securing special permission, a team of highly qualified experts explore the sprawling tunnel systems, finding their way into manmade caverns unseen for decades. The film also documents the horrors faced by forced laborers, compelled to construct the tunnel system under the most inhuman conditions.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: Battle of Midway to Victory in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Battle for Midway, as remembered by a Japanese Submarine Commander and a US Sailor.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: The most fundamental need of any society is a reliable food supply. During WW2, every combatant nation introduced some form of rationing - but that was only the start of the business of keeping the population fed.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Fish
programme.desc: Sole food and more. One of Julia's most memorable meals was the Sole Meuniere she had on first arriving in Paris after WWII. With Jacques, she recreates this dish, as delightful as ever. The sole is followed by grilled halibut with herbed butter, and poached snapper with beautifully turned and sautéed cucumbers.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Soup
programme.desc: Four classic soups made from scratch in Julia's kitchen: aromatic steaming hot French Onion Soup; Vichyssoise, or chilled Leek and Potato soup, as well as an original variation on the theme using watercress; and a hearty Mediterranean fish stew with an authentic rouille. And, because no show about would be complete without Chicken soup, we are presented chicken & noodle and chicken & rice soups.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Eggs
programme.desc: Eggs: all sizes, all types from chicken to quail to ostrich... soft, scrambled, poached... from omelets to Frittatas to eggs Benedict...not to mention Julia and Jacques scrambling an ostrich egg as voluminous as a dozen and a half Grade A Large.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Pork
programme.desc: A classic of the American table--pork chops and applesauce, is the starting point for three J&J improvisations: aromatic grilled, stuffed pork chops with rosemary, served with a tomato, red onion and avocado salad; loin of pork with sautéed red cabbage and apples, and Pork Tenderloin Medallions with port wine and macerated prunes on a bed of orzo.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Potatoes
programme.desc: One Potato, two potato, oh, so many potatoes. Julia and Jacques share their tricks, "trucs" and techniques for perfect baked potatoes, airy mashed potatoes, creamy potato casserole, and delightful lighter-than-air crispy-fried pommes soufflés.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane discovers the history of her historic neighborhood in the heart of central Athens with the city's most renowned urban chronicler, and cooks up a delicious Spiced Roasted Chicken with Toasted Orzo Pilaf, Kale Caesar with Greek yogurt and a Crispy Phyllo Ice Cream Sundae with Honey, Nuts and Halva.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Diane Discovers Her New Athens 'Hood

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane's artist daughter, Kyveli, invites a few gallerists and young artists for dinner in her studio in Exarcheia, a fascinating Athens neighborhood, and Diane cooks up the perfect meal to inspire their insightful conversation. On the menu: Braised Ouzo-Orange Octopus, Zucchini-Herb Phyllo Pie, and a Giant Bean Greek Salad.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors Of The Athenian Art Scene

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane and Chef Lefteris Lazarou, often called the father of modern Greek cuisine, explore the fish market and Diane gets a few lessons on how to choose the best seafood. At his restaurant in Piraeus, Chef prepares a Pan-Seared Grouper and Whole Squid with Spanakopita Puree. Diane, inspired by Chef, creates seafood-stuffed cabbage rolls in her home.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Father Of Modern Greek Cooking

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane prepares a dinner party meal for a handful of her closest friends. Diane provides helpful tips to alleviate the stress that comes with planning a dinner party and provides easy recipes that are healthy and delicious. On the menu: Char-Broiled Cabbage "Steaks" with Pomegranate Seeds and Lemon Zest, Whole Baked Fish with Leeks, and Greek Yogurt Panna Cotta.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - My Greek Dinner Party

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Greece is a cornucopia of age-old natural superfoods. Diane invites a well-known dietician and together they prepare a healthy meal brimming with Greek superfoods including a Spiced Carrot Soup Three Ways, a Black-Eyed Pea Salad with Dried Figs, Pomegranate, EVOO and Herbs; and a dessert of wheat kernels, Greek honey, nuts, and dried fruits called Varvara.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Everyday Superfoods

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: With Athens as a backdrop, Diane explores the foods that so many of us have in common regardless of where we are from. Can soba noodles be grecophied? Can a classic spanakopita be a filling for an American baked potato? Diane answers these questions and ventures beyond tradition into the global world, embracing new ingredients, and christens new recipes.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Foods That Unite Us

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Densely forested mountains, stone-cobbled villages, sheep, and greenery are the stuff of Epirus's mountainous terrain. Diane visits a traditional shepherding family and makes a feta cheese pie baked the way it's been done for centuries: over embers. At home, Diane makes two of her own pies: a Pleated, Buttery Feta Cheese Pie and a Chicken-Phyllo Pie, both inspired by this region.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Pie Heaven

programme.title: Patis Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada. Here, chefs challenge the state's culinary stereotypes, transforming traditional flavors into exciting new experiences.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos

programme.title: Patis Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores Nuevo León: the land of cabrito and carne asada; where chefs challenge culinary stereotypes.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom journey across Costa Rica from the northern Pacific coast to San José. In Nicoya, a renowned Blue Zone, they uncover dietary secrets linked to long, healthy lives. Venturing into the jungle, they work on a coffee plantation and discover why Costa Rica is the world's leading exporter of pineapples.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Costa Rica

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wrangler Tailgate. Since picnickers in 1869 ate food from buckboards of horse-drawn wagons, Americans have loved tailgating. Now the party goes global, with pulled lamb from a wood-burning smoker at Odys & Penelope in L.A. Honey Soy Chicken Wings on skewers and Brisket Tacos, make magisterial main dishes. True global tailgating, with a Peruvian potato salad with chili-spiked cheese sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wrangler Tailgate

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extreme Grilling. Long before grills, charcoal, rotisseries, and planchas, there was fire! We visit L.A.'s Chi SPACCA, for a monster pork tomahawk grilled over wood by chef Ryan DeNicola. Extreme grilling with salmon steaks, smoky, on a shovel in a blazing campfire. Caveman-style pork chops directly on blazing embers with a sizzling poblano pan-fry and decadent brownies on a cedar plank.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Extreme Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Grilling 24/7. The world's pit masters, fire up grills, smokers, or wood-burning ovens for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late night snacks. For breakfast, farm eggs grilled with Parmesan, and prosciutto. For lunch, pizzas from the Industrial Eats in Buellton, CA. Pastrami Beef Ribs make a spectacular supper, and midnight snack of smoky, salty South African Grilled Cheese sandwiches.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: One Good Turn. Rotisserie grilling or spit-roasting combines the smoky sear of grilling with the heat of roasting. Add 3 more benefits: basting, no flare-ups, and the fragrance of wood smoke. Game hens acquire golden, crackling-crisp skin. Spare ribs are given the huli-huli (turn-turn) treatment. Wings get a sweet-salty, lacquer-like glaze. Finally, a whole spinning, sugar-crusted pineapple.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - One Good Turn

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Melting pot extreme, when traditional American barbecue meets authentic ethnic grilling and it's happening across the United States and around the world. Cross-culture mashups, from California paella to a deli-inspired pork loin stuffed with pastrami and sauerkraut. Michelin-starred chef Josiah Citrin dazzles with aged, smoked-roasted duck at his restaurant, Charcoal Venice.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Fusion Q

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: We reinvent the cocktail party, with the power of live fire to take finger food over the top with rum and citrus-glazed jumbo shrimp grilled on sugarcane, "finger-burner" lamb chops from Spain and Smoked Nectarine Bellinis to keep conversation flowing. Sommelier Kristine Bocchino shares suggestions for three great wines to serve at the party.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Grill Top Cocktail Party

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extending from California and the Pacific Northwest to Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Explosively flavored grilled meats with exotic herbs and spices, chilies and umami-rich fish and soy sauce are paired with healthy vegetables-barbecue as health food. Vietnamese and Thai influences make the ultimate street food. Steven visits Jenee Kim for grilled beef short ribs.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Pacific Rim

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The market of San Benedetto in Cagliari is the island's belly. It is one of the biggest fresh produce markets in Europe and arguably said to be the biggest fish market in Europe. A paradise for food lovers, where every stall keeper has a story to tell.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cagliari

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Artisans of Charleston

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Want to turn a veggie loather into a veggie lover? Ellie reveals some tantalizingly simple ways to reform veggie haters, in the kitchen and beyond. Recipes include Broccoli Pesto Pizzas, Beef and Mushroom Sloppy Joes, and Raw Brussel Slaw.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Veggie Love

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Raw foods are on hot now. But cooked foods have unique benefits too. Let Ellie suss out the facts from the hype for you. Recipes include Gazpacho, 3 Ingredient Tomato Sauce, Zucchini Carpaccio, and Wok Charred Lettuce with Shrimp.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Raw Vs Cooked

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie hits refresh on the typical brunch menu with some creative, make-ahead crowd-pleasers that break the mold. Recipes include Eggs Florentine in Tomato Cups, Breakfast Strata, Pumpkin Waffles, and 3 Ingredient Brussel Sprout Hash with Egg.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Better Brunch

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. Recipes include Spinach Salad with Roasted Squash, Pumpkin Seeds and Roasted Grapes, Green Salad with Chicken & Buttermilk Dressing, Cauliflower Tabbouleh, and 3 Ingredient pickled red onions.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: How to buy a week's worth of vegetables, bring out their best, and end up with no waste. Ellie shops a mix of tender and heartier vegetables, showing how to store and prep them as the week progresses. Recipes include 3 Ingredient Grilled Corn with Lime and Basil, Tender Green Salad with Strawberries, Cucumber, Basil, Cod with Kale and Chorizo in Broth, and Savory Carrot-Cashew Soup.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - One Basket, One Week, Zero Waste

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: For Jacques, a rite of spring is to enjoy the salad his father made every year at this time... Spring is also when asparagus appears and he pairs it with grilled tuna. He cooks fresh peas as soon as they arrive in the market and Jacques, not wanting to waste anything, uses the pods to make a soup. He ends with his friend Ed's Pasta Primavera...
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Springtime Favorites

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques suggests that mastering simple skills and techniques will make your life easier and when you're comfortable in the kitchen, you'll be more creative and avoid the trap of a quick fix with a frozen meal...or worse! He teaches you how to sharpen knives, cut and prepare vegetables and eggs and finally make a delicious gratin.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Kitchen Techniques

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. programme.desc: Rafi Gardet (Uma Thurman) is a 37-year-old divorced Catholic businesswoman falling for David (Bryan Greenberg), a 23-year-old Jewish artist. programme.desc: William "Blinky" Rodriguez grew up training in martial arts royalty. At 13, he began his study under one of Bill Ryusaki's top students, Arnold Urquidez. His training partners were kickboxing pioneer Benny "the jet" Urquidez and the rest of the Urquidez fighting clan. Like the rest of the Urquidez family, Blinky stepped into the kickboxing arena and became one of the early pioneers of "full-contact" Karate. For many years, he was one of the most dominating fighters in the ring.

One, the dreaded Oy Vin, still loves Mingse, and can't stand to be without her. Cleverly he gets Chu Chin outside the stadium and there, with two thugs, beats him brutally, and then abuses Mingse. Chu Chin has only revenge to live for. How to beat these vicious gangsters and restore his respect in the gang. He takes to the Karateka for help..!

programme.title: Nobunaga: Warlord of Japan

programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 6

programme.title: Duel of Karate
programme.desc: Twin baby boys are separated at birth when their kung fu master father and mother are slaughtered by an opposing kung fu clan. The two live separate lives, but fate later throws them into a duel to the death with each other. A master class in kung fu cinema highly recommended. Wall to wall action.

programme.title: Chen Village
programme.desc: When you first arrive at Chen village, you are struck by how unremarkable it is. Set in the remote countryside of central Henan, it offers little. That is until you check one fact. 3,000 people live in Chen Village. 2,500 practice Tai Chi Chuan. In China it is known simply as Taiji village. Although a poor village surrounded by farms, it is the birthplace of Tai Chi Chuan and one of the most significant locations in Martial Arts.

programme.title: Mars Villa aka Wu Tang Magic Kick

When his home is attacked by the Fang Kang he effortlessly defeats his opponent, but his wife Mar Tien Liang is horrified to witness such violence. She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

programme.title: Shaolin Chastity Kung Fu

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su escondite de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio negocia con el Chema la libertad de Rutila, pero antes deben repartirse los territorios para evitar una guerra. Andrew presiona a Lay: quiere saber sobre sus vínculos con los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila seduce al Chema, y logra que él le dé su número de teléfono; finalmente, él la entrega a Aurelio. Leonor le confiesa a Victoria que Ignacio trabaja para el Escuadrón de la Muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa entrega a Victoria y Leonor la grabación que incrimina al general Garnica. Leonor la sigue y la encuentra en Villa Catalina. Aurelio, despechado, manda a matar a Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Despechado, Aurelio envía a sus hombres a asesinar a Santiago, pero el atentado se complica cuando Ximena resulta baleada. El Chema averigua que Lay se fue a Colombia, y ordena que la maten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena acusa a Aurelio de haber mandado a matar a Santiago, y él le ruega no decirle nada a sus hijas. Rutila la ve morir y le dice a su padre que lo hará pagar por esa muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila escapa con Ernesto con la esperanza de vivir juntos, y Aurelio se desespera porque sus hombres no logran encontrarla. Chacorta presiona a Víctor para que le dé información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ernesto presenta a Rutila su nuevo jefe, que resulta ser el enemigo número uno de su padre. Aurelio le ordena a Lilo encontrar a su hija, y sospechan que su fuga está vinculada con el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila tiene miedo, y le dice a Ernesto que la tiene que sacar de la casa de Chema lo más rápido posible. La orden es tratarla como una reina, pues aseguran que no saldrá viva de ahí.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria investiga la desaparición de Elsa, y Lucila le asegura que le contará toda la verdad sobre la relación de su jefa y el Chema. Aurelio le pide a Lay averiguar el paradero de Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le dice a Rutila que Ernesto los traicionó a ella y a Aurelio, y le muestra una foto como prueba. Luego pide que Lay le diga a los Casillas que él tiene el tesoro que están buscando.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio teme por la seguridad de Victoria, y le sugiere que traslade a Ernesto a otro lugar. Mientras tanto, doña Alba le aconseja a Ximena que aproveche el caos y se vaya con Luzma y Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a su padre, le dice que se acostó con su peor enemigo y le da pistas de dónde está. Ahora los Casillas quieren acabar con el Chema, pero solo logran atraer a la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria le tiende una trampa a Aurelio, pero es ella quien paga las consecuencias por traicionarlo. Leonor se enfrenta al Señor de los Cielos, y luego de tantos años, al fin logra capturarlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aislado en una celda, Aurelio es torturado y envenenado. Despierta de su letargo cuando recibe la prueba del asesinato de Chacorta. Negocia su libertad para vengar la muerte de su hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio acepta su traslado a cambio de ver a su familia. Rutila lo rechaza, pero le presenta al hijo de Mónica; mientras doña Alba viaja a Sinaloa. Leonor y Casillas son emboscados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y Leonor suben al tren "La Bestia" para huir de dos grupos que buscan atraparlos. Rivero pide refuerzos para enfrentar a los rebeldes, comandados por Marcado y Medardo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y Leonor resisten el asedio de los militares y de las maras. El Chema acusa al Tijeras del asesinato de Chacorta, mientras negocia el contrabando de uranio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor sucumbe ante Aurelio antes de ser rescatados por Rivero y Tim. El iraní recibe el uranio, mientras Tim sorprende a Leonor con un cambio de planes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim negocia con Aurelio para impedir el paso del uranio. Leonor queda fuera del caso Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se enfrenta al Tijeras para cobrarle el asesinato de Chacorta, mientras se salva de la muerte a manos de aliados de Marcado. Julia busca a Leonor para que ayude a Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nancy demanda a su hermana, por ella casi muere ahogada en una competencia de "pancakes". Héctor pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas, su esposa lo traicionó con quien menos lo esperaba.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ashley contrató a un detective para aclarar el crimen de su esposo, pero ella lo resolvió y no quiere pagarle. Andrea culpa a Ruby y a Margy de la muerte de su padre y se disputan la herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Daniela y José es autista, tiene problemas de comunicación, pero si le dan su títere favorito no para de hablar, sus padres no saben qué hacer. Valentina sufre una enfermedad sexual.
programme.sub-title: Obsesión por títere; Semen en mi ojo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis y Pierina tienen una hija con cáncer que no quiere someterse a quimioterapia. Además, Raúl padece el síndrome de Tourette y siente que su novia no lo comprende, solo lo hace sufrir.
programme.sub-title: Salvando a mi hija; Síndrome de Tourette

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Kelvin y Lorena son esposos y periodistas, ella lo envía a entrevistar a un narcotraficante, pero lo secuestran y casi muere. Sharon contrata a Pedro para que le pegue, pero todo sale mal.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sufre de "bullying" y su madrastra la maquilla de muñeca diabólica para que huyan de ella. También, Danny es un usurero que da dinero en efectivo a cambio de usar las tarjetas de sus deudores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivandra queda colgada en una pared de escalar, cuando John deja de sujetarla, ella sufre daños en la muñeca. Los "Pony Play" se disfrazan y Pancho demanda a su esposa por maltrato animal.
programme.sub-title: Me dejaste colgada; Pancho y Romeo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le paga a la esposa de Joel para alquilar su vientre, pero ella cae en coma. Por otro lado, Hilario es un gaucho que maneja con mucha destreza las boleadoras y los tambores.
programme.sub-title: El bebé de la Bella Durmiente; Gaucho con las bolas grandes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Orlando pide que su hermano Neifry deje de comportarse como su madre fallecida. Carla se infecta con una bacteria al hacerse un tratamiento de belleza con peces, ahora exige que cierren el spa.
programme.sub-title: Poseído por mamá; Fish spa chupitos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos demanda a Marcela, su madrastra, para quitarle la custodia de su padre enfermo. Daniel sacrifica burros para preparar una gelatina capaz de sanar a su hijo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivonne alteró la letra pequeña de un contrato para pagar menos, el prestamista lo descubre y la demanda. Acusan a Nicole de ser una mala influencia que arruina la carrera de un cantante urbano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mía estudia periodismo en una academia de Artes y Letras; allí, ganó un concurso literario, pero la organizadora no quiere entregarle el premio porque sostiene que su historia, su vida como prostituta, no es un buen ejemplo para los demás estudiantes. Michel se disfrazó de Kory y se presentó a un examen con la intención de ayudarla, pero fue descubierto y ambos fueron sancionados y expulsados del sistema educativo.
programme.sub-title: Historia de una prosti; Estafa universitaria

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.
programme.sub-title: Dormir o comer; Amor a la muerte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por presión de su esposo se hizo una operación gástrica, ahora siente que no es ella y quiere volver a engordar. Para cumplir con el testamento de su hermana deben sacrificar a un perro.
programme.sub-title: La gula; Entiérrame con el perro

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maritza quiere internar a su padre en un ancianato porque tiene Alzheimer, pero el hombre no quiere porque se siente que está en perfecto estado y aún se siente útil. En otro caso, Kysha perdió su trabajo como seguridad en un hotel porque tenía orden de no dejar pasar a prostitutas y dejó pasar a Frida y a Cindy, sin saber que ellas estaban intentando conquistar a algún hombre adinerado de los que estaban hospedados.
programme.sub-title: Todo por amor; Viviendo en un storage

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paola ayuda a chicos con tendencias suicidas, pero Jefri casi muere presuntamente incitado por ella. Para comprobar la infidelidad de su marido le pone pegamento y picapica a los condones.
programme.sub-title: Club de jóvenes suicidas; La picapica

programme.desc: Jairo sufre un derrame cerebral y al salir del coma tiene una nueva orientación sexual. Consume unos hongos que le provocan alucinaciones y, al otro día, despierta con el clítoris mutilado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La novia de Juan Luis pide un reembolso del dinero con el que financió un restaurante. Irenia exige compensación, la expulsaron de la escuela por matricular a Ruby, quien no era menor de edad.
programme.sub-title: Sueño vs. droga; Falsa menor de edad

programme.desc: Karla usa una aplicación de teléfono para sus compras y se hizo amiga del mensajero, su esposo la acusa de tener sexo oral con él. Un psicólogo trata a sus pacientes con un método peculiar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanesa se casa con Eduardo y comete el error de poner todo su dinero a nombre de él. También, Alejandro quiere recibir terapia de pareja con su esposa Carla para así salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Laura destruyó el dron de Gino que volaba sobre su propiedad, él pide que se lo pague. Mileidy crea una aplicación para identificar enfermedades sexuales y descubre que su esposo es infiel.
programme.sub-title: Propiedad violada; App para enfermedades sexuales

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María y Paula causaron un alboroto ante las intimidaciones de Andrés y Sebastián, ellos las demandan. Elvis miente sobre su edad en papeles oficiales y le niegan la ayuda a su hijo autista.
programme.sub-title: Billetes en carretera; Cambio de edad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena quiere la custodia de su hijo porque su esposo, quien destila alcohol ilegalmente, ofreció un coctel durante una fiesta infantil. Alexis se cambia de género y tiene sexo con su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio no quiere que su hija sea futbolista, porque no tendrá buen futuro, su madre pide la tutela de la joven. Los dueños de una casa confundieron a su empleado con un ladrón y lo lesionaron.
programme.sub-title: Sueño trunchado; Humillado y sin dinero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omaira pide que su suegra desaloje la casa porque interfiere constantemente en su matrimonio y su esposo actúa como un bebé de mamá. Lina hace videos eróticos con globos de diferentes tamaños.
programme.sub-title: El bebé de mami; La looner

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula fue condenada por robar el auto de David y secuestrar al bebé que estaba dentro. Sin embargo, ella alega que el bebé estaba a punto de morir de frío, porque él lo tenía descuidado en el auto mientras se drogaba. La "ley del hielo" no es más que ignorar a la persona con la que se convive y aplicar un silencio sepulcral, que en algún punto puede ser maltrato psicológico. Eso es lo que está haciendo Marcos con su esposa Yésica.
programme.sub-title: Minutos de vida; Ley del hielo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jonatan no quiere que su esposa trabaje más en un Pole Dance donde es popular porque de sus senos brota leche. Mildren demanda al entrenador de gimnasia de su hija por exigirle demasiado.
programme.sub-title: La vaca lechera; La niña gimnasta

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela le exige a Milena una compensación por despido injustificado y por revelar un secreto. Harry pide un masaje prostático, pero al descubrir que el masajista era hombre destruye el local.
programme.sub-title: Auto grande, pito chico; Pánico gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Walker quiere desalojar a su sobrina e hijastra de la casa porque la chica solo ha vivido como una mantenida sin prestarle atención a sus estudios ni a la gestión de la empresa familiar. Carmen preparó la celebración de la renovación de los votos matrimoniales de sus padres, pero el padre, en plena ceremonia, revela que todo ha sido una farsa y que no está dispuesto a seguir viviendo con alguien por la que no siente nada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acepta hacer un documental sobre su vida como indocumentado y ahora está en el limbo. También, Edison y Caroline exigen que su hijo abandone la casa y no se acerque más a ellos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vicky demanda por acoso sexual a Lorenzo, pero solo puede probarlo por el lunar en su pene. El esposo de Eliana le deja herencia a ella y a sus hijas, pero aparece Laura y reclama su parte.
programme.sub-title: Acosador en libertad; ADN vs. cenizas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana le exige a su madre, Teresa, una compensación económica por los años de abandono que vivió. Maribel se sintió intimidada por Carlos y le propinó una golpiza, él pide una indemnización.
programme.sub-title: La hija del difunto; Peligro en la carretera

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Al estar bajo hipnosis Rafael se sintió acosado sexualmente, pide una compensación. El rapero Omni le reclama a Yerald la autoría de una canción, pero no se sabe la letra, porque se la robó.
programme.sub-title: Violado por alma gemela; El rapero sin rap

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Iván es Drag Queen, contrata a Kevin para que le ayude a ser famosa, pero recibe una orden de deportación. Marta demanda a un prestamista, por las presiones de él, la hija de ella se suicidó.
programme.sub-title: Drag queen abusado; Gota a gota

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo. programme.sub-title: UFOs in Spain - The Last Great Wave

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: It seems the world is fascinated with all things science fiction. First it was vampires, then werewolves, and now Zombies. But could this once seemingly far fetched idea be closer to happening then we ever thought possible? Are zombies becoming a reality?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: The dark and mysterious forests of the Ozarks have always been a source of folklore and unexplainable tales. Locals recount their encounters with 'The Fouke Monster', 'The Pope Lick Monster', and the 'Spooklight'.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: From the untamed forests of the Pacific Northwest new evidence that the elusive hairy beast called Sasquatch... IS REAL. This densely forested region also boasts tales of wolf spirits in Oregon and lake monsters in Montana.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Across America, unidentified creatures have terrorized entire towns. With an appetite for residents, cold-blooded, sewer-dwelling reptoids are said to lurk beneath Los Angeles-and in the forests of Tennessee hunters encounter the legendary Wildman.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In July of 2023, David Grusch, a former high ranking US Intelligence officer testified to a US government Oversight Committee that there are alien spacecraft located at secret facilities in the US.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In order to survive mankind must find a way to navigate the galaxy. Alien encounters have offered a possible glimpse into the secrets of interstellar flight, but how would extraterrestrials know how to navigate the vast regions of space?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Rapid advancements in science and technology have given mankind unprecedented access to distant galaxies that could harbor life. And some scientists believe that to find alien life we need look no further than our own backyard.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: As technology advances, more and more people are capturing images of inexplicable objects in the sky.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Examining the possibility that UFOs may be from Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO sightings happen almost every day. But in the court of public opinion the most credible witnesses come from law enforcement. Join us as we investigate the most important police sightings of UFOs.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Between 1981 and 2011, NASA's Space Shuttles flew 135 missions. The Space Shuttle cameras, manned and unmanned, have recorded astounding footage of UFOs that many experts find almost impossible to explain.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many famous UFO sightings occur in remote locations with just a single eyewitness. But some sightings have taken place over large cities with hundreds of witnesses.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker in Nantwich, UK. Something sinister and paranormal seems to be causing havoc inside of the building and tonight it unleashes powerful ghostly activity, which is all caught on camera!

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Malahide, a village in Ireland, has been attached to rumors of reincarnation and near-death experiences. Explore the mystery of Malahide in this episode.
programme.sub-title: Malahide, the Edge of Life and Death

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Explore paranormal phenomena at Sands Lake - from mysterious voices to ghostly encounters. The secrets of this haunting location are unveiled.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Unusual activity has been captured on CCTV at an antique centre in Barnsley, UK. It is suspected that a poltergeist may be the culprit. In search of the truth, paranormal investigator Jayne Harris has been despatched to see if she can gather proof for sceptical shop owner Daniel. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard investigates the practice of past-life regression therapy, a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover what practitioners believe are memories of past lives. A young woman relives a previous life in the American South during the 19th Century. There she experiences a profound loss which helps explain a current life problem; a fear of having children.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Washington to investigate claims that Bin Laden, the man behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of Al Qaeda, was largely a creation of western intelligence groups. A veteran investigative journalist in Toronto argues that Bin Laden was not killed in May 2011 by US Navy Seals, but rather, died as early as December 2001.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Kent in the south of England to investigate reports of werewolf sightings. He meets with an acclaimed paranormal investigator in New York's Central Park who separates fact from fiction regarding the legend of the werewolf, and a journalist describes eye-witness accounts of a bi-pedal, wolf-like creature said to be haunting a lonely stretch of road in Wisconsin.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Memphis, Nashville, Fort Worth, Texas, and Washington DC to investigate the theory that Elvis Presley did not die on August 16th, 1977 but faked his death for a variety of reasons. Jokes of Elvis sightings in Kalamazoo, Michigan aside, there is a considerable volume of evidence to suggest Elvis may not have left the building.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to New Mexico and Arizona to speak with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in July 1947. These researchers have investigated first hand accounts, even death bed testimonials from many of the eye-witnesses to the incident, affirming the existence of such a craft, the ensuing government cover-up and the recovery of alien bodies.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: In this re-examination of the assassination of civil rights leader Martin Luther King, Richard talks to various researchers who offer evidence that, James Earl Ray, was not the real triggerman. The researchers claim the plot was arranged by the highest levels of government and law enforcement. A noted debunker in the skeptic community refutes these claims as inaccurate.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From the Canary Islands to Galicia, passing through Catalonia, in very special places such as the Cañadas del Teide or on the mountain of Montserrat, witnesses and those contacted assure that UFOs have been making appearances for decades; and they claim to have proof of it!

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. Attacks in the middle of the morning, like what happened with Nicolás Sánchez Martín, in Cáceres, or Joan Turu and José Félix Rodríguez, better known as the suicide bombers of Tarrasa, can lead to the death of the witnesses. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Humanity has been plagued by international conflicts and epic powers since the dawn of time. Perhaps our greatest failure is constant strife and division. Could an alien threat force humans to form a united front?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Pyramids are found all over the world and from different time periods in human history. Did humans build the pyramids by themselves - or did they have help? Some experts believe pyramids across the world are part of a grand alien design.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, eyewitnesses have reported UFOs crashing to Earth all over the nation. Most are never found. Some believe crashed UFOs may contain alien technology that could change the course of history

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity? Animal cloning has been a reality for decades but the disturbing experiments going on behind close doors will shock you. Human cloning may be much closer than you think.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Is this half man, half ape simply a figment of our collective imagination or does he really exist? As the evidence begins to pile up maybe we should be asking: who has been keeping this from us?

programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?
